# Declarations

**Funding.** This research received no specific grant from any funding
agency in the public, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

**Conflicts of interest.** The authors declare no competing interests.

**Data availability.** This study uses the sixth and seventh rounds of the
Ghana Living Standards Survey (GLSS6, 2012/13; GLSS7, 2016/17), collected by
the Ghana Statistical Service and available from the Service on request. The
harmonized analysis files derived from those rounds, the financial-inclusion
index documented in Note S1, and the code that produces every table and figure
in this paper are openly available in the `okwaayeli` repository at
<https://github.com/ftsiboe/okwaayeli>; the harmonized datasets are distributed
as release assets and are retrieved programmatically by the analysis scripts,
so the results reported here can be reproduced from the repository without
separate data preparation.
